title: Request a search of plant registration records
summary: You can request SafeWork NSW to search their records to find out if your plant item or plant design has already been registered.
intro:
If you're wanting to find out if any of your items of plant, or plant designs have already been registered, you can request SafeWork NSW to do a search of their records.

You need to make separate requests if:
who_can_apply: The registered owner of the plant item or plant design, or their authorised nominee.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application to search registered plant item or design records'
A letter of authority from the registered owner (if applicable)
The reason for requesting the plant item or design search
Details of the item or design (if known, or applicable), such as the working location

how_to_steps.text: Complete 'Application to search registered plant item or design records – PDF'.
Email your application, supporting documents and payment receipt details to the address on the form.

external_links.text: Application to search registered plant item or design records – PDF

internal_links.text: Notify the relocation or change of ownership of registered plant
Apply to renew the registration of an item of plant
Apply to register an item of plant
Apply to register a plant design

faqs.q: Who can request a search of plant registration records?
faqs.a: The registered owner of the plant item or plant design, or their authorised nominee, can request a search.

faqs.q: What payment methods are accepted for this search?
faqs.a: You can pay using credit or debit cards (Mastercard, Visa, American Express, or UnionPay) or PayPal.

faqs.q: How do I submit my application?
faqs.a: After completing the form and making payment, email your application, supporting documents, and payment receipt details to the address provided on the form.
